question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **addresses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Addresses"** refers to handling or discussing a particular issue or topic. (संबोधित करता है)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher addresses the students' concerns about the upcoming exam.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that this book tackles the main cause of executive derailment and offers incredibly useful skills for working in a fast-paced, goal-oriented workplace. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in blank number 3 is **"addresses"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **addresses**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Demeans **(अपमानित करता है): To cause someone to lose their dignity and the respect of others.

 
 
• **Example:** His rude remarks demean his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **Devours **(निगल जाता है): To eat something eagerly and in large amounts so that nothing is left.
 
 
• **Example: **The lion devours its prey quickly.
 
 
 
• **Neglects** (उपेक्षा करता है): To fail to care for properly.
 
 
• **Example:** She neglects her responsibilities as a team leader.
